financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales under Jefferies Sales Agreement after Dec 31, 2022 (2,942,083 shares)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: Subsequent to December 31, 2022, we issued and sold a total of 2,942,083 shares under the Sales Agreement for aggregate net proceeds of $11.2 million after deducting commissions and offering expenses payable by us.
